turns.content: I need a LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X100VI. Here are the facts: it has a 23mm f/2 lens, a 26.1MP sensor, and 4K video recording. Can you help me craft something that highlights these features?

I created the draft and validated it against the confirmed product facts and requested constraints.

Introducing the Fujifilm X100VI, a powerful camera that features a 23mm f/2 lens, a 26.1MP sensor, and the capability to record 4K video. Discover the versatility and quality this camera brings to your photography and videography projects.
